issues.fact: F4 says only that someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door at a quarter past ten by his watch. It does not say Félix heard the footsteps.
issues.misreading: A solver could take this as confirmation that the 10:15 ascent was audible and deliberate, or that Félix was actively listening for footsteps. That is an added detail about his attention, not a fact the sheet gives.

issues.quote: It has run badly since he died
issues.fact: The sheet gives one watch error only: at the nine o'clock bell it read twenty minutes to nine. It says nothing about the watch's rate or drift over the evening.
issues.misreading: A solver could conclude the watch's error is unknown or changing, so the 10:15, 10:18, 10:21 and 10:32 readings are not reliable as exact times. The sheet does not support any uncertainty beyond the single recorded reading.
